an6.97:1.1: XCVII. Cha yime bhikkhave ānisaṃsā sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya. Katame cha? Saddhammaniyato hoti, aparihānadhammo hoti, pariyantakatassa dukkhaṃ na hoti, asādhāraṇena ñāṇena samannāgato hoti, hetu c'assa sudiṭṭho, hetusamuppannā ca dhammā. Ime kho bhikkhave cha ānisaṃsā sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāyā ti. XCVIII.
